# Om Ramanathan

> Official website of Om Ramanathan, a New Jersey student engineer, founder, robotics builder, and STEM community leader.

## Profile

- [Home](https://www.omramanathan.com/): Overview of Om Ramanathan and his current work.
- [Professional profile](https://www.omramanathan.com/#experience): Experience, education, certifications, volunteering, and skills.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/omramanathan/): Om Ramanathan's public LinkedIn profile.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://www.omramanathan.com/#projects): The Real Temp, RoadSeal, and engineering work.
- [The Real Temp](https://therealtemp.com/): Weather product founded, designed, and developed by Om Ramanathan.

## STEM outreach

- [Outreach](https://www.omramanathan.com/#outreach): Free hands-on STEM workshops led by Om Ramanathan.
- [Light and Sound workshop](https://www.omramanathan.com/#workshop-light-sound)
- [LEGO Bridge workshop](https://www.omramanathan.com/#workshop-lego-bridge)
- [Scratch Coding workshop](https://www.omramanathan.com/#workshop-scratch)
- [Build a LEGO City workshop](https://www.omramanathan.com/#workshop-lego-city)
